messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need a concise triage flow for DP beta pulses. Yesterday's pulse exposed 3 repeat blockers and confusion about ownership. Can we decide an owner model?

jordan: Agree. Proposal: 'pulse triage' ticket created automatically, then assign to either PM (product-facing), Eng oncall (infra/regressions), or Customer Success (setup/UX).

maya: +1 for auto-ticket, but can we push the default assignee to the DP owner if one exists? reduces churn.

sophia: For infra/regressions I want SLA windows. E.g., Sev2 from beta partner = 8h ack, 48h mitigation plan. Is that okay?

alex: Sounds fair. Let's make clear which issues qualify as Sev2: production-affecting regressions, data loss, security. All others are feature feedback.

tanvi: For feature feedback, can we create a weekly synthesis doc for each partner with the top 5 asks and one prioritized request? Helps engineering prioritize.

jordan: Yup — weekly synthesis owned by PM. Also: add a lightweight rubric for acceptance so partners know when a fix/feature is "in scope" vs "nice-to-have".

maya: Draft rubric idea: impact (low/med/high), effort (1-5), risk (low/med/high). Anything with impact=high and effort<=3 => commit in next sprint.

alex: Nice. Who will own the rubric? sophia + pm.
sophia: I'll own the rubric doc. I'll add a short table and examples.

alex: Back to ownership — the flow should be: 1) Pulse arrives -> bot creates ticket in product board with tags (partner, surface, severity) 2) If DP owner exists -> assigned to DP owner, else auto-assign to oncall if severity>=2 else PM triage.

oncall-bot: Automated: Created ticket PROD-BP-6721 for partner "Northwell" tagged severity:2, surface: embeddings. Link: https://jira.example.com/browse/PROD-BP-6721

jordan: Perfect. Now, blocker ownership: if assigned to oncall, oncall must log a triage note within 4 hours with next steps. If it's ongoing dev work, convert to a sprint issue and notify DP.

tanvi: For the weekly synthesis, I'll create a template with: "Top 5 issues", "One prioritized ask", "Suggested acceptance criteria", and "Partner impact note".

maya: Can we add a lightweight feedback loop: after we ship, send a short 2-question survey to the partner: (1) Did this resolve your issue? (2) Was the result acceptable? Simple yes/no + optional comment.

sophia: Good idea. We'll wire the survey via email template from CS. Track responses back to the ticket and add to the partner's feedback log.

alex: Launch criteria for DP features — remind: must have (a) acceptance criteria in rubric, (b) demo with partner, (c) rollback plan and fallback model if applicable.

jordan: Also add perf guardrails: latency regression < 10% on DP traffic or we gate rollback.

tanvi: Who will maintain the partner contact matrix? We need clarity on DP owner per partner + backup.

maya: I'll update the partner matrix spreadsheet today and tag backups.

alex: Action items: @sophia write rubric draft by EOD Friday; @maya update partner matrix today; @tanvi create weekly synthesis template; @jordan add bot ticket rule; alex to write short runbook for oncall triage.

jordan: I'll add the bot rule and put a short example mapping in the product board.

sophia: Rubric draft posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/dp-rubric (will add examples).

alex: Great. Next check-in Wed 10am. If any urgent DP blockers pop up before then, tag this thread and ping oncall. :thumbsup:

tanvi: ack, thanks all :raised_hands:

maya: thanks — will ping when partner matrix is updated.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: DP triage sync Wed 10:00 (calendar invite sent).
